description: This file implements a data provider database and query system for managing provider info, executing queries via a messaging system, and building a provider hierarchy from JSON files.

classes.name: dmQueryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the dmQuery interface, handling request creation, response parsing, and execution logic.

methods.name: makeRequest
methods.description: Constructs and sends a request message over a messaging system, processes the response, and updates query results.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the query by sending the request and processing the response.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the query object.

methods.name: setQueryString
methods.description: Sets the query parameters based on the operation type and input string.

methods.name: setProviderInfo
methods.description: Associates provider information with the query.
